description: Royal Air Force Kittyhawk Mk.IA of 260 Squadron force-landed in the Western Desert in June 1942 and found by an oil survey team near Farafra in February 2012. Placed on outdoor display here in October 2017 for the 75th anniversary of the second battle of El Alamein. The rebuild has been criticised as crude with truck wheels fitted and 112 Squadron shark mouth markings applied although the aircraft served with 260 Squadron. The original engine is displayed alongside. Wrecks and Relics Online last noted it July 2025.
